newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese bonds close near highs, track Bonos.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese bonds close near highs, track Bonos.

text.p: Portuguese bonds closed off highs and dealers said yields could drop to record lows again if Bonos extend gains tomorrow.

"Cash and futures are higher. Support was underlined after the National Association of Purchasing Management said its monthly index of manufacturing activity fell last month, indicating a slowdown in the manufacturing sector of the economy," said one operator in afternoon trade.
Dealers said Bonos could rise further tomorrow if the market bets on an easing in Spanish key rates on Thursday. A rise in Bonos would drag along Portuguese bonds, they said.
The money market closed calm. Overnight and tomorrow/next stood at 7.20/7.25 percent, compared with 7.21/7.27 percent in the morning.
